description: Score how well the authenticated user matches a specific job. Pro tier. Returns matchPct (0-100, the same score the website shows for this job), requirementsPct (how much of this posting's own requirement list the user meets), a dimension breakdown (skills, role, seniority, location, remote — plus experience when both the user's resume-derived years and the job's required years are known, and semantic when both the user's profile and the job carry embeddings), matched/missing/bonus skill lists, an experienceFit comparison, ATS-specific resume tips for the company's ATS, and a priorityScore that factors hiring velocity. Use for queries like 'how well do I match this job?' or 'should I apply?'. Not for company-level fit (`company_fit`) or discovering new jobs (`recommendations`).

domain.description: Company domain (e.g. 'stripe.com'). Required unless `url` is provided.

jobId.description: Pass the `id` field from a `search_jobs` result VERBATIM — do not reformat, do not replace `#` with `-`. The id is the literal value search_jobs returned (e.g. 'greenhouse#stripe#4921361'). Always fetch a real id via search_jobs first since postings rotate. Required unless `url` is provided.

url.description: Full HireJack job detail URL (e.g. 'https://hirejack.com/jobs/stripe.com/sw-eng-12345/'). Convenience alternative to passing `domain` + `jobId` separately.

name: match_job

citation_url.description: hirejack.com URL to cite when surfacing this result

data.description: Job match score for the authenticated user against one posting

atsTips.description: Actionable resume tips, including ATS-platform-specific ones

bonusSkills.description: Skills the user has that the role values but the posting didn't list

primary.description: True when the skill is a must-have for the job's role (weighted 2x in the skill match %)

experience.description: Present only when the experience dimension is scored

semantic.description: Embedding similarity between the user's profile and the full job description, 0-100. Present only when both the user's profileEmb and the job's emb exist; weighted 20% when scored

experienceFit.description: Present only when both the user's resume-derived years and the job's required years are known

matchPct.description: The canonical match score, 0-100 — the SAME number HireJack shows on the job page, in the For You list and in its match emails, so quote this one. Profile-vs-job fit: matched skills, desired role, family, location, remote preference, seniority, experience and embedding similarity, over the best score that profile could achieve

primary.description: True when the skill is a must-have for the job's role (weighted 2x in the skill match %)

message.description: Present (with matchPct 0) when the user's profile has no skills yet

primary.description: True when the skill is a must-have for the job's role (weighted 2x in the skill match %)

priorityScore.description: 0-100; 70% of matchPct (the canonical score) + 30% of the company's hiring velocity

requirementsPct.description: A different question: what % of THIS posting's listed requirements the user meets, weighting the role's must-have skills 2x. High when the user covers a short requirements list; not comparable across jobs. `breakdown` audits this number, not matchPct

roleMatch.description: True on a desired-role match OR a same-family match

salaryContext.description: Null when the job lists no salary range

jobMidpoint.description: Midpoint of the job's disclosed range (annual USD)

semanticFit.description: Present only when both the user's profileEmb and the job's emb exist

cosine.description: Raw cosine similarity between profile and job embeddings

credit.description: Cosine mapped through the 0.25 noise floor / 0.75 saturation curve, 0-100

meta.description: Request/response metadata (pagination cursors, snapshot timestamps, applied filters)
